org.xces.graf.uima
Class UimaUtils

java.lang.Object
  org.xces.graf.uima.UimaUtils

public class UimaUtils
extends Object

Utility functions for converting GrAF graphs into the data structures needed by UIMA. The UimaUtils class simply provides static wrappers for the factory classes.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Keith Suderman
